steps.name: s3-1-import-bounds
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && R=$PWD && cd tools/orb-manager && go vet ./... && go test -run 'SiteLink|SiteImport|SiteBundle|SiteKeep|ResolveOrigin|ThemeOrigin|SiteAllowed|ImageHeader|ArtRefusal|BundleArt' -v . > /tmp/s3-1.txt 2>&1; tail -3 /tmp/s3-1.txt; ! grep -q -- '--- FAIL' /tmp/s3-1.txt && grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSiteImportRefusesAnotherHostBeforeAnyFetch' /tmp/s3-1.txt && grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestResolveOriginRefusesAnUnknownSite' /tmp/s3-1.txt && grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSiteImportRefusesArtOutsideTheLimits' /tmp/s3-1.txt && grep -qE -- '--- PASS: TestImageHeader' /tmp/s3-1.txt && grep -q 'imports themes only from' sitelimits.go && cd $R && test -z "$(git diff --stat s3 -- go.mod tools/orb-manager/go.mod tools/orb-manager/go.sum tools/orb-manager/editor.go tools/orb-manager/security.go tools/orb-manager/web tools/orb-manager/contract apps)" && sh docs/specs/s3-gotest.sh

steps.name: s3-2-editors-fit-pictures
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && R=$PWD && node --check tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/studio@1/studio.js && node --check apps/flights/editor/flights-editor.js && node --check tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/picture-fit.js && make check-pictures 2>&1 | tail -15 | tee /tmp/s3-2.txt && grep -qE 'picture-fit: ([89]|1[0-9])/\1 passed' /tmp/s3-2.txt && grep -q 'fitPicture' apps/clock/editor/watch-engine.js && test -z "$(git diff --stat s3 -- tools/orb-manager/editor.go tools/orb-manager/security.go 'tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1' 'tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/host@1' tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/editors-smoke.js apps/weather apps/clock/app.json apps/flights/app.json)" && make check-editor && make check-runner && make check-migrations && make check-web && sh docs/specs/s3-gotest.sh
